title: Skywatcher sees orange orbs over Picatinny Arsenal during the New Jersey drone wave
summary: Jake Barber tells of Skywatcher sees orange orbs over Picatinny Arsenal during the New Jersey drone wave, about 2024 at Picatinny Arsenal, New Jersey, and says they saw it or took part. As told, not a fact.
